purpose: Visitor preference hints are selected only from stops already on each published 7/10/15 day. Not an alternate road routing model, overnight reservation, traffic estimate, verified opening, or claim a visit fits automatically.

overnightBases.6: Silver City / Porcupine Mountains area, Michigan
overnightBases.15: Lake Superior Provincial Park corridor (verify seasonal lodging)

1.label: Duluth, Minnesota
1.toolAction: See Duluth ship traffic and canal-camera context
1.caution: A good first evening by the canal; actual vessel passages are not guaranteed

3.label: Bayfield / Apostle Islands
3.toolAction: Compare island cruises, trails and kayaking
3.caution: Water access depends on weather, operators and schedules

5.label: Black River / Ironwood
5.toolAction: Choose a realistic Upper Peninsula waterfall outing
5.caution: Extra waterfall walks and side roads must be counted separately

6.label: Porcupine Mountains
6.toolAction: Choose an overlook or trail by available time
6.caution: Park roads and trail access require current confirmation

8.label: Keweenaw Peninsula
8.toolAction: Consider a night-sky opportunity near the Copper Country
8.caution: Copper Harbor and Brockway Mountain add distance beyond the Houghton gateway

10.label: Marquette waterfront
10.toolAction: See reported freighter positions near the ore coast
10.caution: An ore dock view is not a guarantee a vessel will arrive

11.label: Pictured Rocks
11.toolAction: Choose a cliff viewpoint, hike or boat experience
11.caution: Boat schedules, trails and park conditions are separate decisions

12.label: Tahquamenon Falls
12.toolAction: Choose Upper or Lower Falls and check access
12.caution: The falls and Whitefish Point are separate stops, not one stop

13.label: Soo Locks
13.toolAction: Check recorded lock activity before planning a ship-watching stop
13.caution: Lock traffic and vessel passages are not guaranteed

15.label: Lake Superior Provincial Park
15.toolAction: Compare Old Woman Bay and longer park walks
15.caution: Different trailheads and day-use areas have different operating conditions

18.label: Pukaskwa / Marathon
18.toolAction: Judge whether Hattie Cove fits the day
18.caution: The park entrance is a detour, not the roadside Marathon stop

20.label: Thunder Bay / Sleeping Giant
20.toolAction: Plan a separate Sleeping Giant hike, if time allows
20.caution: The park is a significant outing from Thunder Bay, not a quick waterfront stop

23.label: Grand Marais North Shore
23.toolAction: Use the full map to decide where to pause on Highway 61
23.caution: Choose a short stop and protect the border-to-Duluth drive

27.label: Split Rock Lighthouse
27.toolAction: Compare lighthouse grounds and history options
27.caution: Admission, interiors and park access need separate checks

28.label: Gooseberry Falls
28.toolAction: Pick the waterfall walk that suits the remaining day
28.caution: Leave enough time for parking and daylight

30.label: Duluth Canal Park
30.toolAction: Finish at the ship canal and check reported passages
30.caution: Vessel arrival times and bridge lifts may change

notes.driving: Original whole-day itinerary miles / 47 mph × 1.2. Editorial time allowance, not live routing.
notes.crossing: Reserve 45 minutes only when official passenger wait is unavailable; it is not an observed wait. Drive caps measure wheel-time allowance separately from the border reserve.
notes.winter: Winter-sensitive park experiences require independent seasonal verification. The planner must not infer a closure or guaranteed opening.
notes.notEnoughTime: Offer an existing longer published itinerary rather than inventing a roadside overnight or dividing unsourced road miles.
